# 1.28.5 — updating from inside the program works again

A fix release for the built-in updater. Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions
are read as they are.

## What was wrong

On many computers the program found a new version but would not install it: the **Update** button
was missing or vanished a little later, and auto-update downloaded nothing.

The program asks GitHub's API about new releases, and the API answers only 60 anonymous requests
per hour **per internet address**. Behind a VPN, a mobile network or a shared office connection,
thousands of people share one address, and other people's requests use up that limit. In that case
the program fell back to GitHub's release page. That page tells the version number but not the
download link. So a version found that way came with no **Update** button, and auto-update had
nothing to download. A later check could also replace a release it had already found in full with
this incomplete one, so the button disappeared in the middle of a session.

The updater also never said which version it had found. The sidebar showed only the installed
version, and once the download started the card just said "Downloading 37 %".

## What changed

- **The fallback finds the file too.** When the API refuses or does not answer, the program reads
  the release's `SHA256SUMS` file straight from github.com, which the API limit does not cover.
  That file holds the exact name of the Windows build and its checksum, so a version found this
  way gets an **Update** button and installs automatically, still verified by SHA-256 before it
  replaces anything.
- **More reasons to use the fallback.** It used to run only when the API refused (403/429). Now it
  also runs on any API error, when api.github.com is unreachable, and when the API takes longer
  than 10 seconds.
- **A found build is never forgotten.** A later check that knows less about the same version no
  longer replaces what was already found. A failed re-check keeps the found version and its button.
- **The new version is named everywhere**: in the status line ("Downloading version 1.28.6 -
  37 %"), in the sidebar ("v1.28.5 · v1.28.6 available", "… ready to install") and in failure
  messages ("Version 1.28.6 was not installed: …").
- **The download can be stopped, and stopping it is undone cleanly.** While a background download
  runs, its button now says **Cancel**. Before, it said **Update** and clicking it silently stopped
  the download, which left the card frozen at "Downloading 37 %". After a cancel, the card goes
  back to the found version with the **Update** button.
- **A failed check says why.** The card no longer shows "Up to date" when the check did not get an
  answer at all. It shows the reason and an **Open release** button.

## If you are on 1.28.0 or older

The fix lives in the new version, so it starts working only after you have 1.28.5. If your
current copy shows no **Update** button, download 1.28.5 from this page once and replace the old
file. After that the program updates itself again.

## File

`Amarin-Admin-AI-v1.28.5-win-x64.exe` — a single file, nothing to unpack.
